checks.name: scope_fit
checks.evidence: Scope is a cohesive next feature after mvp-foundation: /start, identification, consent, role menu, and read-only participant views.

checks.name: mvp_boundary
checks.evidence: The spec explicitly excludes weekly reports, insights flow, voice processing, captain manual reports, scheduler, PDF generation, production deploy, and out-of-MVP infrastructure.

checks.name: storage_boundary
checks.evidence: Google Sheets remains business source of truth; SQLite is limited to technical dialog/menu state.

checks.name: architecture_fit
checks.evidence: The spec requires thin Telegram handlers, service/repository orchestration, existing notification routing, and tests without production credentials.

checks.name: risk_handling
checks.evidence: Risks cover scope creep, handler/storage coupling, error notification privacy, and progress/history confusion.

assumptions.assumption: The visible Insights menu item remains present because it is part of the approved participant menu, but the full insight flow is deferred.
assumptions.handling: Spec requires a safe temporary response if the button is pressed before the insight feature exists.

assumptions.assumption: Tech spec will decide whether this feature introduces a live Telegram SDK adapter or stays adapter-agnostic with service-level orchestration.
assumptions.handling: User-spec keeps this open and requires tests without production secrets either way.
